gre_gender_identity.definition: The sense a person has of their own gender.
gre_gender_identity.example: Her gender identity was hers to say, and nobody in the room had a vote on it.

temperature.definition: The setting that controls how random the choice of the next token is. Lower values are more repeatable, higher values more varied and less reliable.
temperature.example: For extracting data from a document, keep the temperature low.
